verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an infrastructure-as-code CLI. A tool of this type could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes an embedded AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one; the docs cover only conventional commands such as plan, test, and import.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
